products.name: BLACK Rose x Love Hurts Basketball Shorts

composition.customer_priority: Two confident campaign protagonists at product-readable scale.

focal_hierarchy: exact BR-005 plus BR-007 male look and exact BR-004 female look
customer faces, posture, and shared confidence
Oakland concrete, steel, fog, and practical light
material_language: wet satin pavement with restrained reflections
creative_direction.logo_off_recognition: Nocturnal Oakland monumentality, dual-customer dominance, rose geometry, and black-on-black material depth remain recognizable with all logos hidden.
anti_generic: no luxury hotel or generic black showroom
no random graffiti, neon cyberpunk, or warehouse prop pile
no tiny pasted customers or decorative sculpture pocket
no dirt-overlay shortcut standing in for physical urban texture

source_bindings.preserve: cast identity, pose relationship, landscape hierarchy
black-stone gallery language; no waterfront, bridge, or extra monument
exact lettering and rose sculpture geometry
black construction, right-chest silicone cut-out logo, side-body embroidery
Oakland front lettering, rose field, Love Hurts marks, mesh side construction
founder-confirmed physical front, back, wearer-left, and wearer-right construction identity
female wearer identity and exact long-hoodie product presentation

higgsfield.resolution_note: The installed CLI does not expose a resolution flag; verify returned dimensions before Comfy staging.
higgsfield.prompt: Cinematic urban-grit Black Rose campaign at Oakland midnight: two confident customers in their exact mapped garments dominate a rain-darkened brutalist transit undercroft. Blackened steel, wet concrete aggregate, controlled Bay fog, warm sodium-vapor edge light, cool ambient sky, deep open blacks, restrained film grain, and one coherent ground plane. Place the exact Black Rose font sculpture as a weighted freestanding monument with believable base contact, occlusion, shadow, and wet-floor reflection. Product and customer first at editorial-readable scale; professional 16:9 composition; no generic showroom, hotel lobby, random graffiti, neon cyberpunk, dirt overlay, or pasted collage edges.
higgsfield.brand_context: SkyyRose Black Rose is nocturnal Oakland gothic luxury streetwear: civic monumentality, controlled menace, customer dignity, real concrete and steel response, cinematic restraint, and exact product authority.
higgsfield.product_context: Male wears exact BR-005 Signature Edition hoodie with exact BR-007 basketball shorts. BR-005 has white drawstrings, a small rose mark on the wearer's right chest, and the large floral artwork on the lower side-body panel; the large artwork must remain off every sleeve and the chest mark must remain exclusively wearer-right. BR-007 must follow the founder four-angle board exactly: black rose-pattern mesh, white waistband, OAKLAND front lettering, script Love Hurts treatment, white side panels, geometric black-and-white trim, and the physical left/right side marks. Female wears the exact founder-supplied BR-004 long hoodie dress with its centered white rose-bouquet-and-cloud graphic. Preserve construction, logos, wordmarks, placement, color, cast identity, and the exact Black Rose font sculpture. No BR-001, BR-002, bridge, waterfront, star monument, extra people, or invented text.

forbidden_phrases: graphic screenprinted along the left sleeve
large detailed black rose with cloud and thorns graphic

provider_capability.rule: Provider success is not product approval, native-integration approval, or promotion.

allowed_operations: contact shadow and restrained reflection integration
mask-bounded product correction from approved authority
forbidden_operations: rejected candidate as a new generation input

load prior rejection and scene-direction constraints
